# Chapter 1 — Pairwise collapse (distinct cards, similar speech)

Alpha Fixture nodded once.

Alpha Fixture said, "Gate holds until dawn."

Alpha Fixture said, "Two scouts on the ridge."

Alpha Fixture said, "No fires after dark."

Alpha Fixture said, "Report at the next bell."

Beta Fixture wiped her hands.

Beta Fixture said, "Gate holds until dawn."

Beta Fixture said, "Two scouts on the ridge."

Beta Fixture said, "No fires after dark."

Beta Fixture said, "Report at the next bell."
